## Peripherals
- OS: NixOs 26.05 (linux 6.18.8), niri (Wayland)
- CPU: AMD Ryzen 5 5600X @ 4.7GHz
- GPU: AMD Radeon RX 6750 XT (12GiB)
- RAM: 32GiB DDR4-3333 CL16
- Storage: 512GiB NVMe + 1312GiB Sata3 SSD
- Display: MSI 26.5" MAG 272QP X50 (qd-oled, 1440p, 500Hz)
- Mouse: WLmouse Beast X Mini Pro Solid Pink Rabbit
- Pad: Asus Moonstone L (glasspad)
- Keyboard: Soffle 64 key (gazzew boba u4t)
- Audio: Arturia MiniFuse 2, Philips shp9500, Maono PD100 XLR
